The body said the 1968 Italy–USSR coin toss on its own 'led to' the penalty shoot-out. Sources describe that toss as one example of the decisions by lot that the shoot-out replaced: the IFAB adopted the shoot-out at its AGM on 27 June 1970, and Dagan and Karl Wald are credited as its originators. The sentence now says that embarrassments like this one led to it, and gives the IFAB date (EN/DE/RU).
Spans moved onto the rewritten sentence that gives the answer.

'What consequence was drawn from this embarrassment?' implied that this single coin toss caused the shoot-out. The question now asks which rule change, approved by the IFAB in 1970, ended such decisions by chance. The answer is unchanged.
